What is Locked Earn?
Locked Earn is a fixed lock-up financial product launched by LBank. Users cannot redeem funds early during the lock-up period and, in return, can obtain relatively stable returns.
How are Locked Earn returns generated?
Locked Earn returns come from the platform’s periodic operation of locked assets and the yield pricing mechanism corresponding to the lock-up period, as well as promotional rewards that LBank may provide through marketing campaigns. Returns are calculated according to the rules after the product is established and are settled uniformly on the settlement date.
Why haven’t I received my returns yet?
Common reasons include: the product is still in the lock-up period and returns have not yet been settled; the settlement date has not been reached; returns are distributed uniformly after settlement rather than daily. Please refer to the settlement date displayed on the product page.
When can I redeem the tokens I previously invested?
Locked Earn must be held until the end of the lock-up period. Upon reaching the settlement date, the principal and returns will be returned according to the rules. Early redemption is generally not supported during the lock-up period (if supported, returns will be affected).
How to participate in Locked Earn?
1. Visit and log in to LBank official website;
2. Go to “Earn” > “Locked”.
3. Click “Join now” to subscribe to a Locked product and start earning fixed returns.

## Activity 3: Subscribe to KGST Flexible Products to Enjoy Up to 15% APR
Promotion Period: 2026-11-12 08:00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-11 23:59:59 (UTC)

## Terms & Conditions
## Activity 2, USDe Bonus Tiered APR:
How to participate: Get USDe by trading USDe on the Spot Market, via the Buy Crypto page, or depositing USDe to your Binance account.
Only master accounts are eligible for the Bonus Tiered APR. USDe held in sub-accounts will continue to earn Base APR only and will not be included in the Bonus Tiered APR calculation
Eligible balance: USDe in Spot, Funding and Margin Accounts, including USDe used as collateral. Borrowed USDe and USDe held outside Binance are not eligible.
Bonus tiered APR: Daily Bonus Rewards = Min(minimum snapshot of the day's USDe balance, 100,000 USDe) * 4.75% / 365. Users whose USDe balances are above 100,000 will earn Base APR only.
## Reward distribution:
Base APR rewards are paid weekly in USDe to eligible users' Spot Accounts every Monday.
Bonus Tiered APR rewards will be distributed in USDe as a one-time payment to users' Spot Accounts within 14 business days after the Promotion Period ends.
Users who borrow via Binance Loans or Margin to hold USDe for arbitrage are not eligible for Bonus Tiered APR. Distributed rewards will be deducted.
For more USDe related product information please refer to this FAQ.
This Activity is subject to the USDe Campaign Terms & Conditions.
## Activity 3, KGST Bonus Tiered APR:
Only master accounts are eligible for the Bonus Tiered APR. Sub-accounts will not be included in the bonus reward calculation.
## Reward Distribution:
Real-Time APR: Rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in eligible users’ Earn Accounts every minute. Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for full information.
Bonus Tiered APR: Rewards will be distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts every day. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription). For more calculation details, please refer to this FAQ.
All users who hold open positions for KGST Flexible Products will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards during the Promotion Period. Once the Promotion ends, users will be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards only.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
